msg: Yo, so the advice i was given was that only the colour of gnome matters and that they will always appear in the same pairing group of colours. i.e. orange and brown always together.Also that there are two potential forests , yellow basket forest and red basket forest. The colour of gnome from each of the pairs leads to each forest. So orange will lead to the red basket forest. That one forest/basket will have more mushrooms than the other, but that it randomly changes through the game.My own advice is; i dont think it really matters too much as you cant know how often the amounts would change in each forest anyway. So just pick a colour from each pair and if your getting 6 or more from that colour, stick with it till it starts giving less than 6 and switch to the other colour of that pairing.But i might be dumb and the previous advice may indeed be correct and I didnt notice. Good luck :)
